title: Analytical properties of $q$-metallic numbers
summary: For an integer $n\geq 1$, consider the $n$-th metallic number $φ_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$ (e.g. $φ_1$ is the golden number) and denote by $[φ_n]_q$ its $q$-deformation in the sense of S. Morier-Genoud and V. Ovsienko. This is an algebraic continued fraction which admits an expansion into a power series $[φ_n]_q =\sum_{l=0}^{+\infty} κ_l(φ_n) q^l$ around $q=0$, with integral coefficients.
